script.text: Good morning! I'm Kelly, and this is your daily lesson for November 7. Today we're exploring two powerful ideas together.
Slouch, and you feel smaller, weaker, less confident.  Stand tall, and you feel present, capable, ready.  Posture isn't just body position—it's physical state affecting mental state.

Posture affects breathing, circulation, digestion, and muscle tension. Aligned posture lets systems work optimally. Misaligned posture creates strain, restriction, and dysfunction. How you hold your body affects how you feel.  Power poses increase confidence.
Today's wisdom: Here's today's wisdom: How you hold yourself shapes how you feel and how others perceive you.  Form affects function.
Now let's take what we learned and put it into practice.
Today's growth challenge is Posture Check - How Do You Carry Yourself?.

Here's your activity: Notice your posture right now. Are you slouching? Tense? What's your default when you're not paying attention? Stand or sit tall for one minute and notice how it feels. What would better default posture require? This helps you assess and improve default posture.
And here's how today's lessons connect: What you learned about how you hold your body can be applied to posture check - how do you carry yourself?. Practice makes progress.
That's today's lesson. Learn something, grow a little. I'll see you tomorrow with something new. Stay curious!
